items.title: Privacy Preserving Topic-wise Sentiment Analysis of the Iran Israel USA Conflict Using Federated Transformer Models
items.title_zh: 基于联邦 Transformer 的伊朗—以色列—美国冲突隐私保护主题情感分析
items.summary: The study mines about 19,000 YouTube comments on the 2026 Iran–Israel–USA conflict and combines LDA topic modeling with fine-tuned transformers and federated learning. It reports ELECTRA as the best model at 91.32% accuracy, with 89.59% in a two-client federated configuration while preserving privacy.

items.title: Punctuated Equilibria in Artificial Intelligence: The Institutional Scaling Law and the Speciation of Sovereign AI
items.title_zh: 人工智能的间断平衡：制度缩放定律与主权 AI 的物种形成
items.summary: The paper argues that AI development proceeds through punctuated equilibria rather than smooth, monotonic scaling, identifying five eras since 1943 and four epochs within the current generative-AI era. It proposes an "Institutional Scaling Law" under which institutional fitness is non-monotonic in model scale, implying that orchestrated systems of smaller, domain-adapted models can outperform frontier generalists in many institutional deployment settings.

items.title: An accurate flatness measure to estimate the generalization performance of CNN models
items.title_zh: 一种精确的平坦度度量：评估 CNN 模型的泛化性能
items.summary: The authors derive a closed-form expression for the Hessian trace of the cross-entropy loss with respect to convolutional kernels in CNNs that use global average pooling followed by a linear classifier, then specialize relative flatness to convolutional layers. Experiments on standard image-classification benchmarks suggest the measure can help assess generalization and guide architecture and training choices.

items.title: Semantic Chameleon: Corpus-Dependent Poisoning Attacks and Defenses in RAG Systems
items.title_zh: 语义变色龙：RAG 系统中依赖语料的投毒攻击与防御
items.summary: The paper studies gradient-guided corpus poisoning attacks on RAG pipelines using paired sleeper and trigger documents optimized with GCG; on a 67,941-document corpus, the attacks achieved a 38.0% co-retrieval rate under vector-only retrieval. Hybrid BM25-plus-vector retrieval reduced attack success from 38% to 0% in the reported tests without changing the model or retraining the retriever, though jointly optimized payloads could still reach 20-44%.

items.title: RAW-Domain Degradation Models for Realistic Smartphone Super-Resolution
items.title_zh: 面向真实智能手机超分的 RAW 域退化模型
items.summary: The paper calibrates device-specific blur and noise and unprocesses rendered images into the RAW domain of several smartphones, then trains a single-image RAW-to-RGB super-resolution model that outperforms baselines on real data from a held-out device.

items.title: Low-Field Magnetic Resonance Image Quality Enhancement using Undersampled k-Space and Out-of-Distribution Generalisation
items.title_zh: 基于欠采样 k 空间与分布外泛化的低场磁共振图像质量增强
items.summary: The paper proposes a k-space dual-channel U-Net that reconstructs high-field-like MR images from undersampled low-field k-space and uses an ensemble for uncertainty maps, reporting image quality comparable to full high-field acquisitions on out-of-distribution brain MRI data.

items.title: When Scanners Lie: Evaluator Instability in LLM Red-Teaming
items.title_zh: 当扫描器说谎：LLM 红队测试中的评估器不稳定性
items.summary: The study finds that open-source LLM vulnerability scanners produce attack-success rates that shift with the evaluator, with 22 of 25 Garak attack categories showing instability and reported scores varying by up to 33%. It proposes a two-phase, reliability-aware evaluation framework that raises evaluator accuracy from 72% to 89%.
